thread:
Marta (CS): Morning everyone  kicking off Saturn Retail onboarding. Short thread to lock owners, measurable success criteria, and a sharp 30/60/90 plan.
Jordan (Saturn Retail): Hey all  Jordan here. I'll be the business owner and will provide taxonomy + sample SKUs.
Marta (CS): Proposed owners:
- Marta (CS): program lead, enablement, feedback capture
- Ethan (Solutions): integration, test harness, infra/security runbook
- Pri (PM): acceptance testing, rollout QA, success metrics
- Jordan (Saturn Retail): product taxonomy, UAT sign-off
Sound good?
Ethan (Solutions): Yep. I can deliver a smoke harness and an automated ingest check within 9 business days.
Pri (PM): Draft success criteria:
1) Performance: p95 <= 550ms on Dedicated for search/classify flows under pilot load
2) Quality: category mapping top-1 >= 89% (sample eval)
3) Reliability: 99.5% availability for pilot endpoints; zero P1s in pilot window
4) Enablement: two Saturn engineers run E2E demo + reproduce an eval by day 12
5) Business: procurement target cost per inference <= $0.0035 for pilot volumes
6) Security: sample data cleared by legal and stored under customer-managed KMS in Dedicated
Jordan (Saturn Retail): Procurement target noted. Legal will review sample content; expect sanitized CSV by Tue EOD. We require 90-day retention for artifacts during procurement review.
Marta (CS): Noted on retention  I'll confirm contract exception. Also adding fallback policy: if latency p95 > 550ms, route non-critical requests to a quantized model variant and flag for retry under degraded mode. Pri, can you flag that in acceptance doc?
Pri (PM): Done. I'll also add nightly regression evals and an alerts page in Redwood Console. We'll wire severity >= S2 to on-call.
Ethan (Solutions): Small infra note: prefer pre-signed S3 URLs for sample upload. Will provide a short ingest script and a runbook snippet (to paste in their repo).
Jordan (Saturn Retail): We'll use pre-signed URLs. Also confirm Dedicated deployment with KMS + audit logs enabled.
Marta (CS): Confirmed Dedicated + customer-managed KMS requested. I'll loop in security for onboarding clearance.
Ethan (Solutions): Repo snippet I'll give them:
``` 
# quick ingest example
aws s3 cp samples.csv s3://saturn-onboard/ --region us-west-2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/evals -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-v2","eval_set":"s3://saturn-onboard/samples.csv"}'
```
Pri (PM): Proposed 30/60/90 milestones (concise):
- 030: sample ingest, first smoke run, enablement workshop, baseline eval
- 3160: 3-store pilot, performance tuning, cost report v1, alerts live
- 6190: widen to 15 stores, stability window, renewal readiness packet
Jordan (Saturn Retail): Renewal review in month 8; we'll need a cost cadence report monthly to bring to procurement.
Marta (CS): We'll set up a monthly cost dashboard and run Optimize early to hit the cost target.
Pri (PM): Risks (quick list)  react with :+1: to accept or add: 
- Procurement cost threshold not met ($0.0035/unit)
- Legal/PII clearance delays
- Longer-than-expected latency on peak traffic
- Need for custom fine-tune or label correction work
Jordan (Saturn Retail): :+1: on risks. Legal will aim to clear samples within 48 hours.
calendar-bot: Created invite "Saturn Retail  Onboarding Workshop" Wed 10:00 PT  attendees: Marta, Ethan, Pri, Jordan
Marta (CS): Next concrete steps:
1) Jordan uploads sanitized CSV to pre-signed S3 (Tue)
2) Ethan runs smoke harness + posts run logs (within 9 bd)
3) Marta publishes acceptance checklist + wires retention exception request (today)
4) Pri readies nightly eval job and alerting config (week 1)
Jordan (Saturn Retail): Uploading samples tonight and will ping here once live.
Ethan (Solutions): I'll kick off the ingest validation as soon as the URL is posted.
Marta (CS): Feedback plan: 1-question pulse after workshop + weekly 30-min sync. We'll capture NPS and any blockers in the shared onboarding doc.
Pri (PM): Anything else to add?
Jordan (Saturn Retail): All set from our side. Thanks  excited to get launched.
Marta (CS): Thanks team :rocket:
